about: Tower layers (r276, docs/depth-tricks.md §2): an IMAGE layer wrapped round a cylinder in the view's middle, its scroll turning it, darker toward its sides; seen from close by (r350, w05-w08), its courses arcing and the set behind wrapped round it as panoramas (PanoramaBatch, Godot's plax_panorama.gd). Godot draws its own strips (plax_tower.gd's draw); jME runs core's ParallaxLayer.drawTower. Written by core/test-data/tower/make_round.py. Read by shots/.../ParallaxShots, engines/godot/tests/shots.gd and engines/jme's JmeParallaxShots.

scenes.name: tower-full-turn
scenes.about: Hiver's set behind a brick tower 20% of the world in radius (16 wide, in the view's middle), its wall six images round, shaded 0.65: a full turn in 12 s, half a turn at 6 s

scenes.name: tower-fogged-flipped-padded
scenes.about: the tower flipped on X, a pad of 1 between its images (the set shows through the gaps), shaded 0.8, half a turn backward, under a page fog of 0.02: libGDX's page fog shader takes the darkness in the batch colour's blue. Lint (b), known: layer 0's bottom edge (parallax4#3 at 52%) shows through the gaps in front, unseen in the stills; kept (r405).

scenes.name: tower-trimmed-trees-repeat-y
scenes.about: Hiver's far peaks (a region the atlas trimmed top and bottom) wrapped round a radius of 30% (24 wide), shaded 1 (black at its sides), flipped on Y, tiled up a page repeating on Y with a pad of 1, a quarter turn. Lint (b), known: layer 0's bottom edge (parallax4#3 at 52%) shows through the gaps in front, unseen in the stills; kept (r405).

scenes.name: tower-dolly-cross-fade
scenes.about: w01 dollied in from zoom 1 to 0.7 (the tower at its own zoom, about the view's middle), cross-fading into w02 4 s in, over 4 s

scenes.name: tower-near-full-turn
scenes.about: w01 seen from close by (r350, towerCamera 3.3 radii, the r266 mock's field of view): the courses arc about the view's middle, and Hiver's four layers, all slower than the tower, wrap round it as panoramas, wider and taller toward the sides

scenes.name: tower-near-fogged-flipped-padded
scenes.about: w02 seen from 2 radii: the panoramas show through the pads, under the page fog; the trees (0.04), faster than the tower turning backward (0.035), stay flat. Lint (b), known: layer 0's bottom edge (parallax4#3 at 52%) shows through the gaps in front, unseen in the stills; kept (r405).

scenes.name: tower-near-trimmed-repeat-y
scenes.about: w03's ridge seen from 4 radii, tiled up a page repeating on Y: each row of the wall scaled about the view's middle, the set behind wrapped round. Lint (b), known: layer 0's bottom edge (parallax4#3 at 52%) shows through the gaps in front, unseen in the stills; kept (r405).

scenes.about: w05 dollied in from zoom 1 to 0.7 (each panorama in its own view), cross-fading into w06 4 s in, over 4 s
